Permafrost Redoubt.name: Permafrost Redoubt
Permafrost Redoubt.description: The user plants their feet and grows overlapping layers of stone-hardened ice across their whole body, widening into a frost wall that shelters a group behind them for the rest of the scene. Gunfire, blasts, falling rubble and charging foes hit the user instead without breaking through, and attackers who strike them take cold damage, but heat softens the wall and the user cannot take a step while holding it. Strain: severe.
